study type: Preclinical animal study (fertility and developmental toxicity)
exposure: Maternal Group B Streptococcus (GBS) six-valent polysaccharide conjugate vaccine (GBS6) administration
cohort: Female Sprague Dawley rats and New Zealand White rabbits administered the GBS6 vaccine prior to mating and twice during gestation, along with their offspring.
finding: There was no evidence of vaccine-related effects on fertility, embryo-fetal development, or postnatal development of the offspring, and functional serum antibodies to GBS6 were confirmed in maternal animals and most offspring.
followup_time: End of lactation period for offspring
